channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em 45% no segundo turno, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on Saturday (16) shows a technical tie between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a simulated 2026 runoff, with both candidates at 45% of voting intentions. The result reflects a highly polarized electoral landscape in Brazil.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da nota do DC que lança Joaquim Barbosa ao Planalto
item.description: The Christian Democracy (DC) party officially launched Joaquim Barbosa, former president of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), as its pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, replacing former minister Aldo Rebelo. The party’s statement emphasizes Barbosa as a unifying figure who can restore public trust in institutions and respond to society’s demand for change.

item.title: Datafolha: Avaliação negativa do governo Lula recua para 39%, e positiva oscila para 30%
item.description: Lula’s government negative approval dropped slightly from 40% to 39%, while positive approval rose from 29% to 30%, according to a Datafolha poll released Saturday. Among Lula voters, 68% rate his government as good or excellent, whereas 75% of Flávio Bolsonaro supporters view it negatively. The survey, conducted May 12–13 with 2,004 voters aged 16+, has a two-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Pré-candidatura de Joaquim Barbosa à Presidência já está posta, diz presidente do DC
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy party (DC), João Caldas, confirmed that former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa is the party's pre-candidate for president in 2026, replacing Aldo Rebelo. The decision was announced in an interview with Broadcast.

item.title: A popularidade de Lula no Datafolha a menos de 5 meses da eleição
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 30% of voters rate Lula's government as good or excellent, 39% as bad or terrible, and 29% as regular, indicating stability compared to April's round. The institute interviewed 2,004 voters between May 12 and 13, 2026, with a two-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Negative evaluations are higher among men (41%) than women (37%).

item.title: Datafolha: 39% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo e 30% aprovam petista
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll, released on May 16, shows that 39% of Brazilians rate President Lula's government as bad or terrible, while 30% approve and 29% consider it regular. These figures remain stable compared to the April survey, which showed 40% disapproval, 29% approval and 29% regular evaluation. The poll interviewed 2,004 people aged 16 or older between May 13 and 14, prior to the controversy involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete subir rampa do Planalto com condenados do 8/1
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that if he wins the 2026 presidential election, he will bring those convicted of the January 8, 2023 attacks to walk up the ramp of the Planalto Palace in 2027. He described the defendants as victims of political persecution during a speech in Sorocaba, São Paulo. The remark reinforces a narrative of amnesty and reintegration for participants in the anti-democratic acts.

item.title: DC lança Joaquim Barbosa como pré-candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Christian Democracy party officially announced Joaquim Barbosa, former president of the Supreme Federal Court, as its pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, replacing Aldo Rebelo. The party states Barbosa embodies national unity and the restoration of public trust in institutions. Rebelo criticized the move as an 'affront' and vowed to remain in the race.

item.title: DC filia Joaquim Barbosa, fala em candidatura a presidente e abre crise com Aldo Rebelo
item.description: The Christian Democracy (DC) party affiliated former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa and announced him as its pre-candidate for president, triggering an internal crisis with former Defense Minister Aldo Rebelo, who had been the party’s presumptive nominee. Party president João Caldas stated the change was made 'by the people' and that Rebelo failed to poll, while Rebelo rejected the move as a violation of transparency and democratic processes within the party.

item.title: TSE diz que teste confirma segurança das urnas
item.description: The TSE completed the second phase of the Public Security Test of Electronic Voting Machines, held from May 13 to 15, 2026, in Brasília, confirming the security of Brazil's electoral system. No findings compromised vote secrecy or integrity, and previous expert recommendations were incorporated. Final reports will be published on July 22, followed by the Digital Signature and Sealing Ceremony for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Indignação de Zema com Flávio era de vidro, e já se estilhaçou!
item.description: Romeu Zema expressed outrage for just 48 hours after condemning an audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro asked Daniel Vorcaro for money, calling it a 'slap in Brazil's face.' Yet, he quickly reconciled, offering 'the other cheek.' The reaction was brief and fleeting, highlighting the volatility of political alliances.

item.title: Datafolha: Governo Lula tem 39% de avaliação negativa e 30% de positiva
item.description: According to a Datafolha poll released on May 16, 2026, 39% of Brazilians evaluate President Lula's government as bad or terrible, compared to 30% who rate it as good or excellent and 29% who consider it regular. The negative assessment exceeds the positive by 9 percentage points, indicating wear and tear after three years and four months in office.

item.title: IA pode ampliar disseminação de fake news nas eleições
item.description: The use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections may amplify the spread of fake news, particularly amid political polarization and low digital literacy. Experts warn that electoral justice may lag behind evolving AI-driven manipulation tactics, akin to doping staying ahead of anti-doping efforts in sports. Minister Nunes Marques of the TSE prioritizes countering AI’s harmful effects, promoting debate and dialogue, and fostering unity among electoral courts to avoid either overly interventionist or overly liberal approaches.

item.title: José Dirceu reafirma apoio à reeleição de Lula
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu reaffirmed his support for Lula's re-election and stated he will focus his federal deputy candidacy on supporting Fernando Haddad for São Paulo governor and Simone Tebet for the Senate. He also emphasized the PT's goal of electing 15 federal deputies and avoiding a 'historical setback'.

item.title: Empate Lula-Flávio? Pesquisa Datafolha pré-“Dark Horse” já nasce morta
item.description: The Datafolha poll showing a 45%-45% tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was deemed irrelevant because it was conducted mostly before the 'Dark Horse' scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro was exposed. Since most interviews took place prior to the revelation, the data fails to capture the scandal's impact on voter intentions, rendering the poll useless for predicting post-controversy electoral dynamics.

item.title: Zema tem recorde de ‘curtidas’ ao criticar Flávio Bolsonaro, mas também ganha desafetos
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, gained record social media engagement after criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro for allegedly negotiating with banker Daniel Vorcaro over sponsorships for a film about Jair Bolsonaro, calling the act 'unforgivable'. The video garnered over 4 million views, but drew internal criticism from Novo's Paraná directory, which called the move premature and misaligned with national party convention, while also ruling out a potential Flávio-Zema ticket.

item.title: Zema diz que crítica a Flávio por áudio com Vorcaro é ‘página virada’ e que não houve ruptura
item.description: Romeu Zema said his criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro for requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro was a 'closed chapter', denying any political rupture and stating they will unite in the second round against Lula. He said he acted according to his principles, but the alliance scenario remains unchanged.

item.title: Morre o locutor mineiro Milton Naves aos 67 anos
item.description: Milton Naves, a renowned Mineiro broadcaster, died at 67 in Belo Horizonte after over 50 years in radio, including 40 at Rádio Itatiaia and coverage of nine World Cups. His passing was mourned by former governor and presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema, who praised his lasting impact on Mineiro radio and sports culture.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reforça intenção de manter candidatura: ‘Não vou desistir’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reaffirmed his presidential candidacy in a speech in Sorocaba, stating he will not give up fighting for Brazil following the controversy over messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro. He accused the Lula government of politicizing the Federal Police and criticized the replacement of the delegate who investigated Lula’s son, Lulinha. A Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro at 45% each in a potential second-round runoff.

item.title: Efeito Master deixa Datafolha prematuramente envelhecido
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll, released this Saturday, was deemed prematurely aged because interviews were conducted before the revelation of a conversation in which Flávio Bolsonaro asked Daniel Vorcaro for money to fund a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. This recent context — involving allegations of influence peddling and private funding for political purposes — was not captured in the survey, rendering its data outdated and potentially misleading for understanding the current electoral landscape.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe título de cidadão sorocabano
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was awarded the title of Citizen of Sorocaba on Saturday, the 16th, during an event that also launched the pre-candidacy of Deputy Guilherme Derrite for the Senate. The honor was granted by councilwoman Tatiane Costa (PL), who said she entered politics inspired by former President Jair Bolsonaro. The ceremony took place in Sorocaba, São Paulo, and was reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ignora ‘Dark Horse’ em ato de pré-candidatura de Derrite
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended Guilherme Derrite’s Senate pre-candidacy event in Sorocaba, where he avoided directly mentioning his 'Dark Horse' film project and instead emphasized resistance rhetoric, accusing an STF minister of electoral interference and vowing to restore Jair Bolsonaro to the presidency by 2027. He made unverified religious claims, falsely attributing a quote about 'doing the devil' to Lula when it was actually Dilma Rousseff who said it in 2013. His tone contrasted with the previous day’s event in Campinas, where he openly questioned whether Jair deserved a film and affirmed the project’s funding through private means.

item.title: Datafolha: 9 em cada 10 brasileiros não se arrependem de ter votado em Lula ou Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Datafolha poll shows 91% of Brazilians do not regret voting for Lula or Bolsonaro in the 2022 election. Among Lula’s second-round voters, 89% have no regrets (up 2 points since April), while 94% of Bolsonaro voters express no regret. In the 2026 presidential scenario, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 45% in a potential runoff.

item.title: Empresa de administrador do fundo utilizado para captar recursos para filme sobre Bolsonaro comprou imóvel nos EUA
item.description: The Mercury Legacy Trust, linked to lawyer Paulo Calixto, purchased a home in Arlington, Texas, for $753,500 in February 2025. The property is located in the area where Eduardo Bolsonaro resides in the U.S. and is tied to the Havengate Development Fund LP, which received $2 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. André Porciúncula, former Bolsonaro government culture secretary, signed the purchase as Mercury’s representative, raising suspicions of political use of funds against the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo diz manter candidatura pelo DC e critica Barbosa
item.description: Aldo Rebelo confirmed his presidential pre-candidacy for the DC party, stating he was chosen by the national leadership to lead a project of unity and development for Brazil. He criticized the mention of former minister Joaquim Barbosa as a 'trial balloon' and an affront to transparency, emphasizing his unblemished biography and experience in public administration and Congress as the foundation of his campaign.

item.title: Zema chama crise com Flávio Bolsonaro de “página virada”
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema stated that his conflict with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stemming from criticism of the senator’s conversations with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, is now over and represents a 'turned page'. The remark came days after Zema had labeled Flávio’s request for funds from the businessman as 'imperdonable'.

item.title: Filme sobre Bolsonaro aparece classificado no gênero de crime, no site especializado IMDb
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro, is listed under crime, biography, and drama on IMDb following the release of audios where Senator Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly sought sponsorship from banker Daniel Vorcaro. The movie reportedly received R$62 million from Vorcaro, though the producer denies any connection to his name appearing on the platform. The 2018 assassination attempt scene may have contributed to the 'crime' genre classification.

item.title: Homens são expulsos de evento com Flávio em Campinas
item.description: Two men, André Cardoso and Gabriel Sesonelli, were restrained and removed by security at an event in Campinas launching Guilherme Derrite’s Senate pre-candidacy. The incident occurred after they publicly criticized Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas, leading to their mistaken association with PT militants. The event organizers and Derrite’s team have not issued an official statement.

item.title: Após embate com Gilmar, Fachin pauta Ferrogrão e reforma trabalhista
item.description: Following a confrontation with Justice Gilmar Mendes, STF President Luiz Edson Fachin scheduled for the upcoming plenary session the rulings on the constitutionality of the law enabling the Ferrogrão railroad and the labor reform rules restricting access to free justice. Fachin moved to resume the cases after public and private pressure from the Court's dean, including a WhatsApp message accusing him of obstructing the docket via 'filibuster'. The cases — ADI 6553 (Ferrogrão) and ADC 80 (labor gratuity) — had been stalled, though Justice Barroso had already voted to approve the environmental change for the railroad.

item.title: A plano inusitado que Zema pretende implementar caso seja eleito para a presidência
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo party, promised a national plan for a 'moral shock' if elected president, focusing on reforms to the STF and the Executive-Legislative relationship. The goal is to overcome the current crisis between Brazil's powers, described as one of the worst in recent years, through strategic alliances and institutional adjustments.

item.title: Datafolha: 91% dizem não se arrepender de voto em Lula ou Bolsonaro
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on Saturday, the 16th, shows that 91% of Brazilians say they do not regret their vote in the 2022 presidential election between Lula (PT) and Jair Bolsonaro (PL), while 8% say they do regret it. The survey indicates high stability in voter choices despite the polarization.

item.title: Apór definir como 'imperdoável' o áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro, Zema diz que vídeo com críticas ao senador é 'página virada'
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for president, initially called Flávio Bolsonaro's audio request for money from Daniel Vorcaro 'unforgivable,' but later retracted, saying the matter is 'a closed chapter.' His initial criticism caused backlash from Bolsonarist allies and within his own party, though he maintains there is no rupture on the right and that all will unite in a potential runoff against Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, irmão de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested R$134 million from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance the biopic 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, in a November 2025 message. The request was made with a tone of familial closeness and urgency, linking financial support to the film's production. The message was disclosed on May 16, 2026.

item.title: O próximo Datafolha para medir o impacto da negociação Flávio Bolsonaro-Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Datafolha is set to release a new poll on Friday, May 22 or Saturday, May 23, 2026, based on 2,004 interviews with a two-point margin of error, to measure the impact of the revelation of conversations between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding funds for the 'Dark Horse' propaganda film. The survey will include direct questions about Flávio’s conduct, the perceived closeness between him and Vorcaro, and the effect of the revelations on voter intention, including whether his supporters believe he should withdraw his candidacy.

item.title: Por que o DC quer descartar Aldo Rebelo ao Planalto e trocá-lo por Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: The Christian Democracy party (DC) replaced Aldo Rebelo with Joaquim Barbosa as its presidential candidate for the 2026 elections, following Barbosa’s affiliation in April. The shift occurred quietly and signals a new strategy to strengthen the party’s presidential ticket. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Caiado promete usar o Exército contra facções se for eleito presidente
item.description: PSD pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado promised to deploy the Army against criminal factions if elected president. However, he acknowledged that only 33% of the population currently knows him, posing a significant challenge to his campaign.

item.title: Zema se diz decepcionado com Flávio, mas prega união no 2º turno
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president and former governor of Minas Gerais, said he is disappointed with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over allegations that the senator received R$ 61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', calling the relationship 'imperdoável'. Despite criticizing the episode, Zema stated it is a 'closed chapter' and signaled a potential alliance with the bolsonarist bloc in the 2026 election runoff to defeat the left and the PT.

item.title: Zema ventila nome do Novo para vice na chapa de Mateus Simões em MG
item.description: At a Novo Party event in Belo Horizonte, city councilwoman Fernanda Altoé was floated as a potential running mate for Mateus Simões (PSD) in the 2026 gubernatorial race, with former governor Romeu Zema mentioning her support. She expressed readiness for the role and confirmed her pre-candidacy for state deputy under Novo. Former federal deputy Tiago Mitraud also made himself available to the party for any needed position.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa será candidato ao Planalto em 2026, diz presidente do DC
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa will be the pre-candidate for president of Brazil in 2026 for the Christian Democracy (DC) party, as confirmed by party president João Caldas. This replaces the earlier pre-candidacy of Aldo Rebelo, who showed weak polling performance. Barbosa, previously considered by the PSB in 2018 and 2022, is notable for his role as rapporteur in the Mensalão trial.

item.title: Flávio usa caso de criança com doença rara para atacar Anvisa. Veja vídeo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used the case of a child with Duchenne muscular dystrophy to criticize Anvisa during an event in Sorocaba, claiming the agency delays approval of essential medications. The child’s mother stated the treatment costs R$17 million and that Anvisa remains unresponsive, causing daily muscle loss in her son. This comes after Anvisa temporarily suspended Elevidys in July 2025 due to risks of acute hepatic failure.

item.title: Carlos diz que discutiu nomes ao Senado com Bolsonaro
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro stated he discussed potential Senate candidates with former President Jair Bolsonaro during a two-hour meeting in Brasília, as determined by Alexandre de Moraes. He said the trip aimed to fulfill filial duties and convey supporter support, while updating his father’s health status following shoulder surgery, with rehabilitation expected to last 6 to 9 months. Carlos described Jair Bolsonaro as a 'politically persecuted' figure subjected to daily torture and cut off from external communication, emphasizing bolsonarist articulations for 2026 in Santa Catarina and São Paulo.

item.title: Caiado: Se eleito, farei parceria com governadores para combater crime organizado
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that, if elected, he would work directly with governors to combat organized crime and strengthen border control. He emphasized the need for a coordinated approach between the federal government and states to address public security challenges.

item.title: Derrite sai em defesa de Flávio: 'Acharam que tinham uma bomba atômica'
item.description: Federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) defended Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during the launch of his pre-candidacy for the São Paulo Senate, stating that the episode involving the money request to banker Daniel Vorcaro is a 'closed page'. He claimed his opponents thought they had an 'atomic bomb' against the senator, but the matter has already been overcome. Both politicians were together in Sorocaba this Saturday.

item.title: José Dirceu mantém pré-candidatura após diagnóstico de linfoma
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT-SP) reaffirmed his pre-candidacy for federal deputy following a lymphoma diagnosis, announcing he has begun chemotherapy and intends to continue his political campaign to re-elect Lula and support Fernando Haddad as governor of São Paulo and Simone Tebet for the Senate.

item.title: Lula está com o diabo e nós estamos com Deus, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he intends to maintain his 2026 presidential candidacy, claiming he is being persecuted. He commented on recent revelations about his relationship with former banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master during a political event in Sorocaba, São Paulo. The lawmaker also repeated the controversial phrase 'Lula is with the devil and we are with God'.

item.title: Como uma deputada do PT aparece no roteiro no filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The film Dark Horse, depicting Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory, includes a scene based on the 2014 incident in which he insulted deputy Maria do Rosário (PT-RS), saying she 'does not deserve' to be raped because she is 'too bad' and 'too ugly'. In the fiction, she is named Glória and interrupts Bolsonaro's interview, shouting 'And you? Are you a rapist!', to which he responds that he is not a rapist and, if he were, he would not rape her. The scene ends with Eduardo Bolsonaro intervening to separate them.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa se filia ao Democracia Cristã e deve disputar Planalto
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa joined the Christian Democracy party in April and is expected to run for president in 2026, replacing Aldo Rebelo as the party's pre-candidate. Party president João Caldas stated the change was 'impersonal and partisan' and that Barbosa has already been launched as a pre-candidate, with full autonomy to set his agenda. Barbosa, 71, gained prominence for presiding over the STF and reporting the Mensalão trial, and was named one of the 100 most influential people by Time magazine in 2013.

item.title: Os Tribunais de Contas são indispensáveis?
item.description: Constitutional Amendment 139/2026 establishes the essentiality and permanence of Courts of Accounts, prohibiting their extinction, creation, or installation, reinforcing their irreplaceable role in external public administration control. This change addresses the gap identified by the STF in ADI 5763-CE and aligns the Courts of Accounts with the constitutional treatment reserved for the Public Prosecutor's Office and Public Defender's Office, ensuring their independence and functional exclusivity.

item.title: Ciro Gomes lança pré-candidatura ao governo do Ceará após descartar disputa ao Planalto
item.description: Ciro Gomes launched his pre-candidacy for governor of Ceará under the PSDB, after ruling out a presidential run, with Roberto Claudio as his running mate. He leads in polls against current governor Elmano de Freitas (PT), but trails Camilo Santana in simulations. The race is marked by a family split, as his brother Cid Gomes (PSB) backs the PT-led ticket.

item.title: Integrante do time de inteligência de Trump defende maior integração entre Brasil e EUA
item.description: Felix Lasarte, a member of Trump's Presidential Intelligence Council, advocated for stronger economic integration between Brazil and the U.S., including ending visa requirements, following a meeting between Trump and Lula at the White House. The Planalto Palace expects deeper bilateral alignment in the coming months.
